name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – § 5/2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: amounting to the level of Article 5 of the Washington Treaty and Article 42(7) of the Treaty on European Union, avoiding a repetition of the 1994 Budapest Memorandum,
part_context: Underlines that any peace agreement must not put limitations on Ukraine’s ability to defend its sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity and, as an effect thereof, make it vulnerable to future attacks; underlines that such an agreement must offer credible security guarantees to Ukraine amounting to the level of Article 5 of the Washington Treaty and Article 42(7) of the Treaty on European Union, avoiding a repetition of the 1994 Budapest Memorandum, and reconfirm that Ukraine has the freedom to choose its security and political alliances free from any Russian veto;
